summary: Autonomous ticket runner conventions: .agent/RUNNER_CONVENTIONS.md (lifecycle, single-lease exclusivity, ground-truth rule, retry policy, human-gate escalation, state-mutation rules) referenced additively from AGENTS.md and docs/development.md; stdlib-only scripts/validate_packet.py (required headings, lease keys, empty-section rejection, multi-path CLI); append-only scripts/state_audit.py (append idempotent per ticket, verify must cover every completed ticket, bootstrap from BUILD_STATE evidence sha; STATE_AUDIT_PATH/BUILD_STATE_PATH overrides; importable path-param functions) with bootstrapped docs/reports/STATE_AUDIT.jsonl (10/10 covered); pytest suite services/api/tests/test_runner_conventions.py; CI validate-job step (validate_packet + state_audit verify) and Makefile governance additions.

tests.name: validate_packet negative (missing Acceptance + lease key)
tests.evidence: exit 1; stderr: 'missing required Acceptance section heading', 'missing lease key: orchestrator_run_id'

tests.name: state_audit verify after bootstrap
tests.command: python3 scripts/state_audit.py bootstrap && python3 scripts/state_audit.py verify
tests.evidence: bootstrap created 10 entries; verify exit 0, printed 'audit: 10/10 covered'

tests.name: state_audit append idempotence
tests.evidence: first 'appended', second 'exists'; /tmp/audit_demo.jsonl has exactly 1 line; real audit untouched by the demo

tests.name: validator logic in-process
tests.command: direct function checks (validate_packet.validate_packet, state_audit append/verify/bootstrap with tmp paths)
tests.evidence: empty-section rejection, lease-key rejection, append idempotence, bootstrap sha extraction ([a-f]-requiring regex so CLIP-004's numeric CI run id is stored as 'unknown', not a fabricated sha), verify coverage all asserted

tests.name: architecture_guard
tests.evidence: all 6 rules OK (adr-set, bounded-modules, provider-neutrality, registry-contract, ci-topology, build-state)

tests.name: secret_scan
tests.evidence: clean; new files additionally reviewed (no secrets/credentials; only run-id actor string and UTC timestamps)

tests.name: workflow YAML parse + wiring
tests.evidence: pyyaml parse OK; 'Validate task packets and state audit' step present after the validate_state/architecture_guard step; 4 jobs retained (validate, test, quality, build)

tests.name: pytest (21 prior + new runner-convention tests)
tests.evidence: pytest is not installed in this sandbox; pip/network unavailable (Python 3.x system python, no venv). CI re-runs outside the sandbox; test logic for the new file was verified in-process (see validator-logic entry).

tests.name: ruff format --check / ruff check / mypy
tests.command: python3 -m ruff format --check services/api; python3 -m ruff check services/api; python3 -m mypy services/api/clipos_api
tests.evidence: ruff and mypy not installed in sandbox; pip/network unavailable. Code written to the existing formatting conventions (double quotes, trailing commas, sorted imports). scripts/ is outside the mypy target path.

tests.name: commit on agent/CLIP-005
tests.evidence: git index write blocked: /srv/clipos/clipOS/.git/worktrees/CLIP-005/index.lock on a read-only filesystem. Completed change set left in the working tree; orchestrator commits or re-runs outside the sandbox.

security_rights_budget_impact: none (local validators and append-only audit; no network, no external side effects, no secrets; strengthens state-transition auditability)
known_limitations: pytest/ruff/mypy gates not runnable in this sandbox (tools absent, no network/pip); orchestrator must re-run outside.
commit blocked by read-only git index; change set is uncommitted in the worktree.
